reminder_hours.label: Last call — check in and log

2026-09-25.mindset: Write your current daily routine vs your ideal daily routine.
2026-09-25.business: Review all business models available to you, take notes.

2026-09-26.physical: Bodyweight circuit, 3 rounds: 10 push ups, 10 squats, 10 crunches.
2026-09-26.business: Pick ONE business model and commit to it.

2026-09-27.physical: 30 min walk in nature / touch grass.
2026-09-27.mindset: Set up a workspace that helps you focus and feels enjoyable (lighting, candle, plants, whatever works) and post a photo of it.
2026-09-27.business: Identify the strengths and weaknesses of that model for you.

2026-09-28.mindset: Set a fixed sleep and wake time, and hold it from tonight.
2026-09-28.business: Work out how many modules your program has and roughly how long it'll take. Build a realistic schedule to finish it within the next 7 to 10 days.

2026-09-30.physical: Bodyweight circuit, 3 rounds: 10 lunges each leg, 10 russian twists, 30 sec plank.

2026-10-01.physical: Active recovery: 30 min hike or long walk.
2026-10-01.mindset: Gratitude journal: write 5 things you're grateful for, then reflect on week 1 and how it went.
2026-10-01.business: Watch the program + write a summary of what you've learned so far.
